protocol.alignment: Lag=round(renderer latency93 + nominal attack44.1 - physical decay start delay*44100). Production uses35ms; each30/35/40ms fixture uses its paired physical delay. No delay is fitted from validation.
protocol.gain: One RMS scalar per complete render from original note36 only; fixed throughout other notes, chords and whole-sequence comparison
protocol.harmonic_policy: Independent 80ms harmonic/chord quadrature fits to hardware and candidate. Power residual<=1% and condition<=100. Hardware-only harmonic floor-45dB. Chords additionally require isolated H1/H2/H3 with noise-proxySNR>=20dB. No harmonic determines a gain or curve.
protocol.integration_verification: Required separately before interpreting physical-model scores
